name: claude-sync-antigravity
description: GCSA (Claude Sync Antigravity): Unofficial bridge where Claude plans and reviews, Antigravity agents execute. Not affiliated with Anthropic or Google.

tools.name: agy_task
tools.description: Start a task on Antigravity (read or edit).

tools.name: agy_wait
tools.description: Wait for a running task to finish.

tools.name: agy_result
tools.description: Read the result of a finished task.

tools.name: agy_approve
tools.description: Run approved commands requested by Antigravity and continue the task.

tools.name: agy_models
tools.description: List available models, remaining quota and tier.

tools.name: agy_usage
tools.description: Show the usage report and quota.

tools.name: agy_desktop_task
tools.description: Start a task inside the Antigravity desktop app.

tools.name: agy_swarm
tools.description: Start a parallel run (split or compare).
